title: 婦嬰新說 / Fu ying xin shuo

titles.title: New Treatise on Women and Infants
titles.note: Not an official catalogue English title.

abstract.zh: 《婦嬰新說》（Fu ying xin shuo）由合信氏（Benjamin Hobson）著、管茂材同撰，館目著錄為1858年上海仁濟醫館刊本，論述女性生殖解剖、妊娠、分娩、嬰幼兒疾病及當時方藥，並附醫學圖說。資料可供醫學史、翻譯史與圖說研究初步檢索、定位及回圖查核。本版依牛津Bodleian Libraries所藏Sinica 1792，提供128面忠實轉錄及p129–137九面的版本與流通史導讀，導讀不收該章操作正文；JSON、TXT及TEI保留原字、原刻句讀、細註、圖字與官方原件連結。v0.2.0經獨立AI讀稿比較及逐面非盲回圖裁定，未經人類全文校勘，疑讀已標記。
abstract.en: Fu ying xin shuo (婦嬰新說), written by Benjamin Hobson with Guan mao cai and catalogued as an 1858 Shanghai edition issued by Ren ji yi guan, discusses female reproductive anatomy, pregnancy, childbirth, childhood illness and historical remedies, with medical illustrations. The dataset supports preliminary searching, location and image checking for medical history, translation and illustration research. Based on Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford, Sinica 1792, this edition provides a source-faithful transcription of 128 faces and a bibliographical and circulation-history guide for the nine faces p129–137, without that chapter’s operational text. JSON, TXT and TEI preserve source characters, printed punctuation, small notes and diagram labels, with links to the original. Version 0.2.0 uses independent AI reading comparison followed by nonblind, face-by-face source adjudication; no human full-text collation has been performed, and uncertainties are marked.

methods.zh:
固定牛津Sinica 1792影像為唯一取文底本。初錄v0.1.0公開後，才開封未見初錄的獨立AI讀稿；本輪裁定者已看兩稿，且承接初錄脈絡，因此是非盲來源裁定。全128面實際回圖，比較差異，同時覆看兩稿相同但有風險的原字、數字、句讀、小註及圖字，另作整頁盤點。必要局部影像只保留原像素，不增墨；未以通行本、現代詞或數值關係補正文。新增漏錄及刪除同處重錄均見CHANGES，細註附著處見ANCHORS，未解字與字形群見UNCERTAINTIES及GAIJI。p129–137九面仍只作版本與流通史導讀，未轉錄該章操作正文。館目1858年與題頁刊記提供版本背景，當冊印次、成書及掃描日期仍未知。

JSON主本機械衍生TXT與TEI，逐單元核字串、順序、來源及疑讀位置，另以官方TEI P5 4.12.0 Relax NG及CFF 1.2完整schema驗證。這些是格式和追溯檢查，不是全文準確率。實際原生模型、effort、tokens、現金用量及人工逐字時間未回報，均保持未知；語義追溯檢查因unknown-model真實回傳exit 3，未稱完全通過。人類全文校勘、專家及同儕審查均未執行，也沒有測得字誤率。只有高層方法公開，提示、專用程式、裁片及完整工作紀錄不公開，不能單靠本包重跑全部讀字流程。
methods.en: The fixed images of Bodleian Sinica 1792 are the sole transcription witness. Only after v0.1.0 was publicly released was the sealed, independently produced AI reading opened. The adjudicator saw both readings and continued the initial-transcription context, so this stage is explicitly nonblind. All 128 faces were viewed again, comparing differences and checking concordant high-risk characters, numbers, punctuation, notes and labels, with whole-face inventory. Necessary details preserve source pixels. Other editions, modern terminology and numerical relationships do not supply source text. The nine guide-only faces remain excluded from transcription. Actual impression, composition and scan dates remain unknown. Mechanical JSON/TXT/TEI checks and schema validation do not measure accuracy. Exact native model, effort, token and cash counters remain unknown; the semantic provenance check retains a real exit 3 for unknown-model. Human full-text, expert and peer review were not performed. Only this high-level method is public; the complete reading process cannot be rerun from the released package alone.
